INSERT INTO dispatch.plafond_jour (coursier_id, jour, plafond_unites, devise)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
             ON CONFLICT (coursier_id, jour)
             DO UPDATE SET plafond_unites = EXCLUDED.plafond_unites,
                           devise = EXCLUDED.devise,
                           declare_le = now()
